description_excerpt: Job Description We are looking for a skilled SAP Data Migration Consultant to join our SAP team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the extraction and upload of master and transactional data in the SAP ECC system. The role requires solid experience in ABAP development for data extraction and hands-on experience with various data migration tools and techniques for uploading, such as LSMW, BDC, BAPI, and IDoc.
